snippet.title: Temple Run 2 Arcade Promotional Video - Coastal Amusements
snippet.description: http://arcadeheroes.com - This is the new promotional video by Coastal Amusements for their new Temple Run 2 Arcade game. While it is promoted as a ticket redemption game, that can be turned off in the options if the operator wishes. Check out Arcadeheroes.com for more info.
